title: Halting time with positive amplification parameter
statement: Let $N$ be a finite nondeterministic machine, let $r,t$ be natural numbers, let $\mathrm{dec}:\mathbb{N}\to\{\mathrm{false},\mathrm{true}\}$, and let $x$ be a Boolean input word. If $N$ halts on $x$ after every choice word of length exactly $t$, then the amplified machine with parameters $r$ and $\mathrm{dec}$ halts on $x$ after every choice word of length exactly $t+r(2t+3)+1$.
hypotheses_covered: The original machine halts on input $x$ for every choice word of length exactly $t$
